primary.unit: distinct evaluated WAV SHA256; unitId fallback is only for test fixtures without audio
primary.negativeEvent: At least one wrong-target query for the same WAV is matched. Overall aggregation ignores case, source and query count.
primary.positiveEvent: The result of the correct-target query for each distinct WAV. Duplicate copies do not create additional trials.
primary.clearPositiveAbstention: (uncertain or unavailable) / all predeclared clear positive WAV units
primary.negativeFalseAcceptance: any wrong query matched / all negative WAV units
primary.missingResults: unavailable; retain in the full declared denominator
primary.subgroups: Apply the unchanged limits separately within each declared source, generator, case and language/contrast category; subgroup rates do not replace the overall union.

parentStress.negativeEvent: Any derivative WAV has any wrong-target query matched.
parentStress.clearPositiveAbstentionEvent: Any predeclared clear positive derivative returns uncertain or unavailable.
parentStress.purpose: Additional worst-derivative robustness stress view, not the original per-utterance estimand.

dependence.ordinaryWilsonInterval: Unadjusted binomial description only; correlated TTS/VC waves do not establish independent population confidence.
dependence.clusterReporting: Report parent roots, lexical roots and voice families. Parent stress rates are descriptive and not a newly introduced quality threshold.

history.legacyProtocol: Reports without protocolVersion used the initial implementation, referred to as protocol 1.
history.correctionOne: Promoting source-parent worst over four different VC WAVs to the primary 5/10/20 gate was an accidental extra requirement, beyond the original per-utterance metric.
history.correctionTwo: Including case in the overall negative unit key counted a WAV once per counterexample case, diluting the required any-wrong-query union.
history.preservation: Keep all protocol-1 reports and their then-failed calibration conclusions unchanged. New protocol-2 recalibrations use new output paths and bind this JSON SHA256.
history.timing: Correction recorded before final model/threshold freeze and before any new blind audio was generated. No failed sample is deleted and no percentage limit is relaxed.
